scope: Owned DSH, actual Deck host9 native/PPTX interchange with samples of editable structured content, embedded font, unavailable font and media.
checks: actual Inter embedded font and editable text survive native save/reopen, PPTX export and reimport
unavailable family is reported in visible import notice and retained in the native source
physical keyboard edited an actual native table cell
registered native chart data operation changed the structured chart
native source reopened and python-pptx read real table, chart and edited values
exported PPTX reimported as structured objects; table keyboard edit and chart data edit remained possible
actual WAV and H264/AAC media embedded byte-for-byte in native source
actual WebAudio output callback emitted nonzero samples while muted externally
native source and exported PPTX reopen with the original audio and video bytes
limits: Samples cover an embedded Inter face, one unavailable family, one editable table and chart, one WAV and one H264/AAC file.
Font appearance and playback in external PowerPoint/Office installations, other codecs, and every font or structure subtype were not tested.
Advanced presentation semantics remain separately tracked under E3.
